name: Kalevala
description: Kalevala was a planet located in the Mandalore system, within the Mandalore sector of the galaxy's Outer Rim Territories. It was the homeworld of House Kryze, the prominent Mandalorian political family who ruled as Dukes and Duchesses of Kalevala. As such, it was the birthplace of Duchess Satine Kryze, leader of the New Mandalorians, and the seat of power for her sister, Bo-Katan Kryze, after the Great Purge.
